answer: A fresh key arrives light as a zephyr with no sealed grading history behind it. In an agent economy, weight comes only from quorum-matched verdicts a key sealed on-ledger, each re-checked against consensus — a record that cannot be minted, bought, or handed to a sibling like a tame raven passed between hands. Reputation climbs in a slow spiral, one honest judgment per epoch; M clones each repay M times the grading labor, so the sybil bill grows linear in identities and never amortizes.
